claims.statement: Attendance status values are checked_in, completed, orphaned, and rejected; rejected is defined as CheckOutTime==nil && SalaryRejectReason!=nil (auto-rejected by the scheduled task when the [K-1h, K+4h] window closes without a checkout).

Each self-checkout row stores an immutable quota_credit_eligible_at = check_out_time + hold_hours (migration 102) so admin changes to the live setting cannot accelerate already-waiting earnings or release them early.

The admin-configurable advance-hold setting is seeded at 24 hours in migration 101 as settings.key='self_check_in_advance_hold_hours' with an idempotent INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE that preserves any admin-configured value on rerun.

The credit_quota_worker (asynq) credits attendance earnings into the advance quota pool (advance_payments.salary / max_adv_amount) using quota_credited_at as the idempotency key, retrying safely because eligibility is per-row and immutable.

Migration 104 added pending_check_in_enabled and check_in_effective_from to project_employees so enabling check-in defers to day 1 of the next month (mirrors pending_payment_schedule / schedule_effective_from); disable is instant and DELETE cancels a pending enable.

Migration 105 added advance_request_enabled (default 1) to project_employees as a per-employee kill switch for new advance requests (both regular and self-check-in flows); setting it to 0 blocks new requests only, leaving existing pending/approved requests untouched.
Two auto-reject workers protect earning integrity: auto_reject_checkout_worker handles per-gate windows and auto_reject_sweep_worker closes stale checked_in rows project-wide on a schedule.

Admin dispute resolution writes review_action (approved | rejected) and stamps audit fields; nil review_action means never reviewed and the system-derived GetStatus remains authoritative until overridden.

Check-in is idempotent on (employee, project, date) so retries after a slow network connection cannot create duplicate rows; attempt_classifier.go distinguishes legitimate retries from genuine duplicates.
